items.name: calendar-01
items.description: Calendar 01: Single month. Card with one month and a selected day.

items.name: calendar-02
items.description: Calendar 02: Two months with a range. Two adjacent months with a selected date range and a summary line.

items.name: calendar-03
items.description: Calendar 03: Date and time slots. Booking layout: a month on the left, a list of time slots for the selected day on the right.

items.name: calendar-04
items.description: Calendar 04: Presets. Calendar with quick presets (today, tomorrow, next week) as buttons below.

items.name: calendar-05
items.description: Calendar 05: Date picker in a form. Form with a date-picker field (button trigger plus a calendar popover) and a native time input.

items.name: charts
items.description: Charts gallery. Nine chart cards in pure CSS and SVG: bar, line (one and two series), area, stacked area, donut, radial, horizontal bars and a sparkline.

items.name: dashboard-01
items.description: Dashboard 01: Sidebar, KPIs, chart and data table. Complete dashboard page: app shell with sidebar, KPI cards, an area chart card and a data table.

items.name: dashboard-stats
items.description: KPI cards with label, value, trend and note

items.name: hub-launcher
items.description: Grid of launcher cards for modules or settings sections

items.name: login-04
items.description: Login 04: Form with image on the right. Reversed split layout: form on the left, image panel on the right, three social buttons.

items.name: login-05
items.description: Login 05: Magic link, minimal. No card and no password: one e-mail field that sends a sign-in link, with a social fallback.

items.name: onboarding-checklist
items.description: Setup card with progress and a checklist of actions

items.name: otp-03
items.description: OTP 03: Four digits with back link. Four-digit PIN on a muted page, with a back link and a resend hint.

items.name: settings-page
items.description: Section navigation next to stacked settings sections with rows and a danger zone

items.name: sidebar-06
items.description: Sidebar 06: User footer with dropdown menu. The footer user opens an account menu (popover, no JavaScript).

items.name: sidebar-07
items.description: Sidebar 07: Collapsible to icons. A checkbox and :has() collapse the sidebar to an icon rail. Click the panel icon in the bar.

items.name: sidebar-08
items.description: Sidebar 08: Inset with secondary navigation. The page sits in a rounded inset card; the sidebar blends into the page background and carries a secondary nav.

items.name: sidebar-09
items.description: Sidebar 09: Double sidebar (rail and panel). An icon rail selects the section; the second sidebar lists that section.

items.name: sidebar-10
items.description: Sidebar 10: Team switcher header. A header button opens a popover menu to switch between workspaces.

items.name: sidebar-11
items.description: Sidebar 11: File tree. Nested folders from details elements, using the submenu guide lines as tree lines.

items.name: sidebar-12
items.description: Sidebar 12: Calendar sidebar. A date calendar and a calendar list inside the sidebar, for planner and agenda apps.

items.name: sidebar-13
items.description: Sidebar 13: Sidebar in a dialog. A settings dialog with a sidebar for its sections; opens with invoker commands, no JavaScript.

items.name: sidebar-14
items.description: Sidebar 14: Right sidebar. The sidebar sits on the right edge (oc-sidebar--right).

items.name: sidebar-15
items.description: Sidebar 15: Left and right sidebars. Navigation on the left, an inspector panel on the right.

items.name: sidebar-16
items.description: Sidebar 16: Sticky header. The bar stays pinned while the page content scrolls underneath.

items.name: signup-03
items.description: Signup 03: Muted background with social buttons. Sign-up card on a muted page: social buttons, divider, e-mail form and legal line.

items.name: status-page
items.description: Split 404 / 403 / 500 page: big status code panel next to a card with title, text, detail and actions

items.name: watch-layout
items.description: Video page: 16:9 player column with title, channel and description, plus an "Up next" list

items.name: form-builder
items.description: Admin form builder: field cards you can reorder, a palette of field types and a dialog per field

items.name: masonry-gallery
items.description: Project gallery: masonry grid with captions, a CSS-only category filter and the lightbox

items.name: media-manager
items.description: Admin media manager: documents, videos and photos of one item with upload, reorder, select and delete

items.name: services-tabs
items.description: Services section: one tab per service with a hero image or video, text, key points and documents (no JavaScript)

items.name: cms-dashboard
items.description: CMS admin home: dark sidebar with sections, top bar with page title and user, flash message, content tiles and recent changes

items.name: chat-inbox
items.description: Split chat inbox: searchable conversation list with unread dots and the selected message thread with a composer

items.name: infinite-carousel
items.description: Infinite carousel: after the last slide the first one slides in from the right, no rewind

items.name: pricing-plans
items.description: License pricing as on omniaui.eu: launch offer, plans with a yearly/lifetime switch per card, a featured plan, VAT note and checkout help

items.name: spotlight-cards
items.description: Spotlight cards: product cards whose glow and border light follow the mouse
